page.overview:
What is CP9?

CP9, more properly known as , is a secret Cipher Pol agency, formed of people able to use the Six Powers techniques. They are the main antagonist group of the Water 7 Saga, specifically the Water 7 and Enies Lobby Arcs. The organization's agents are also the central characters from CP9's Independent Report Cover Page Serial.

Unlike the eight official Cipher Police groups, CP9 agents are not centered on intelligence gathering but instead specialize in the covert assassination of targets deemed a threat to the World Government. Members are gathered at childhood and are trained both physically and mentally to become powerful killers, discarding emotions in order to become more efficient in missions. Rob Lucci, the most powerful member in the organization's history, had become almost incapable of mercy or accepting weakness due to this. However, younger agents such as Kaku have demonstrated a wider array of emotions and even compassion, proving the mind-molding is not always successful.

CP9 had been subdivided into two teams when the whole group was not needed for a mission. One group consists of Kaku, Blueno, Kalifa, and the leader, Lucci; this group was sent to Water 7 to retrieve the blueprints of the Ancient Weapon Pluton from Iceburg. The other group was sent to crush certain Revolutionary Army agents, led by Jabra and having Fukurou and Kumadori under him.

The CP9 are based in Enies Lobby's Tower of Justice, where they act as the final guardians of the Gates of Justice. It has been said that Enies Lobby's reputation of being impossible to conquer is due to the generations of CP9 and their strength. It was also stated that this generation of CP9 is the strongest in its history. Due to their extreme power, it seems that they all have rather arrogant and pompous attitudes; because of this, members of CP9 absolutely refuse to believe that "pirate scum" (no matter how powerful) could defeat them, which ultimately caused their downfall at the hands of the Straw Hat Pirates.
